request: Bring the Abbaas Ledger in line with the refined final canvas at https://claude.ai/artifact/XpzsEF5ovaU7cB3wYp5bEi so the app matches it exactly: the new Home look with sends on the left of the centre line and payments on the right, the reworked Send and Receive forms without the note field, the after-saving preview, the Receive quick amounts or the over-payment warning, and the new save motion where Home grows from the form's button. Version one is integrated at f1ffe1d in /Users/Yuki/Claude/abbaas-ledger; sign-in, storage, totals, Undo, layout and install behave as before.

values.observation: Home matches the refined board: there is no title, the two boxes start at the top with the name pill in the top corner and the amount on the outer edge with its cents at half size; under the totals an Entries heading shows the count; each entry is a tinted card on the centre line, sends left of the line and payments from Abbaas right of it, with who holds what after it on the other side; the list fades out above the Send and Receive buttons.

Tapping Send opens the blue form as on the refined board: a close button and who holds what at the top, New entry · Send above the title Money sent for Abbaas, a USD/MVR switch with a sliding white pill, the amount in large type, in USD the line Dollars go straight onto the balance. No rate needed., paid-to chips where the chosen one shows a tick and a dashed New person chip, a date chip reading Today with the day and month, and a white Send · $250.00 button at the bottom; there is no note field and no after-saving preview, and saving puts the entry on Home left of the centre line.
